name: URL (All Protocols + www)
description:
Detects URLs with explicit protocols (http, https, ftp, ssh, mysql, smtp, etc.) and bare www. URLs. May contain sensitive information including credentials, paths, or query parameters.

Note: May contain PII or credentials in query parameters, paths, or authentication strings. Also matches bare www. URLs without a scheme.
Protocols: http, https, ftp, ftps, ssh, sftp, smtp, mysql, postgresql, mongodb, redis, ldap, telnet, and others

effect.message: URL tokenized, protocol and domain visible for de-identification
